'''Vile Vigour''' is a spell within the [[Arceuus spellbook]] that requires level 66 [[Magic]] and the completion of [[A Kingdom Divided]] to be cast.

Casting Vile Vigour will convert the player's [[prayer points]] into [[run energy]] at a 1:1 ratio. Only the amount of prayer required to reach 100% run energy is consumed; if the player's remaining prayer is insufficient, all available points will be converted. Players can only cast Vile Vigour once every 10.2 seconds.

==Trivia==
* The spell icon for Vile Vigour depicts the {{Wp|caduceus}}, a symbol representing {{Wp|Hermes}} in Greek mythology. Hermes is, among other things, considered the god of speed and athletes, making his symbol appropriate for a spell that restores run energy.
* This spell appears to be a reworked version of the Divine Grace prayer that was [[Chambers_of_Xeric#Forgotten_prayers|mentioned as a potential reward]] from the [[Chambers of Xeric]], where prayer points were drained instead of run energy, but was scrapped alongside two other prayers.
** The prayer was offered again in the form of [[Ruinous Grace]], where it was part of the scrapped [[Ruinous Powers]] prayer book that was intended to be a reward from completing [[Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire]].
